From the archive · Antwerp 2023

Competencies & connections

Two sessions on creative learning and collaboration across distance.

Dates
13–14 April 2023
Location
University of Antwerp, Rector Dhanis
Kleine Kauwenberg 14, 2000 Antwerp, Belgium
13 April
13:30–15:00 CEST · Room SR.006
Onsite & online
14 April
15:30–17:00 CEST · Room s.K.101
Onsite only

13 April · A resource for creative competencies

A hands-on workshop explored the Design Competency Resource, developed through earlier Cumulus gatherings. Participants co-created case studies and considered adding art competencies to develop a broader Creative Competency Resource. Contributors included Job Rutgers (OCAD University) and John Fass (London College of Communication).

14 April · Intimacy over (Long) Distance

This session explored sustaining international artistic projects during the ecological crisis, building on methods developed during the pandemic.

Minna Suoniemi shared approaches from contemporary art, lens-based practice, ecology and ethics courses. Andreas Kohli presented a summer school connecting local investigations of extractivism in Athens, Melbourne and Taipei. Merav Salomon (Bezalel Academy of Art & Design) presented international collaborative courses developed in response to Covid-19.
